title: full-set triage: why the bench host is red where CI is green

findings.claim: lane H's backup and restore tests ran the bare psql and pg_dump from PATH, red on a host whose PostgreSQL is not on PATH; fixed: the tests hand in the test cluster's own client tools

lane H's fixtures built box trees under the run's umask, so at umask 0002 the product rightly refused them (deploy/.env, deploy/site, a passphrase folder writable by the group); fixed (ruled b): the fixtures make their folders with explicit modes, and one test per guard shows a group-writable one still refused

lane D's backup tests ran the bare psql and pg_dump from PATH (58 reds on the bench host), and backup.py met a missing client tool with a bare FileNotFoundError, a restore after it had emptied the schemas; fixed: the tests hand in the cluster's client tools, backup.py refuses the tool by name and setting before any change
findings.place: tests/unit/test_backup.py, test_backup_restic.py, test_backup_busy_night.py, test_restore_drill.py; tools/trialbox/backup.py _client, dump, take_snapshot, restore_db

findings.claim: the console's Node Playwright check ran at import inside a skipif, once per importing module, so a node slower than 60 s made every importing module a TimeoutExpired traceback, in every xdist worker (112 on the bench host); fixed: checked once per test process, a timeout one plain line, never a skip

test_erasure_reach errored at setup on the bench host (226): the test server's vector extension was older than the db image's pin (public.halfvec missing; the integrator's 7155060416), not XML; fixed: the test cluster's fixture stops the run once, plainly, on a vector older than the pin

the compose test stack and a box installed on the same host shared the compose project name trialbox, so make up-test could reach or re-create the installed box (the compose stage's 401s and its backup red fit this, not run here); fixed (ruled a): the test stack is project trialbox-test, and make up-test refuses by name what another project or program holds of its ports and names
findings.place: Makefile TEST_PROJECT, COMPOSE_TEST, up-test; tools/test_stack_free.py; tools/failure_drill_box.py

findings.claim: more tests ran the bare psql or pg_dump from PATH: test_ops_pages and test_admin_screens_209c, test_backup_without_pause, test_update_path, test_db_image (its skip under TB_STRICT_SKIPS shown), and seven more (test_backup_vector_store, test_t728_asof_restore_optouts, test_restore_hold, test_restore_roles, test_lane_b_on_the_train, test_backup_licensed_terminology, test_erasure_reach_restore); fixed: each hands in the test cluster's client tools
findings.place: tests/console/test_ops_pages.py, tests/integration/test_db_image.py, nine files in tests/unit/, tests/pg_client.py

findings.claim: about 30 key and KEK tests read the checkout's deploy/.env as the box's: make up-test copies it from .env.example, which names no TB_ENV, so after a compose stage the checkout is a PRODUCTION box and the key commands refuse; fixed: each key test gives the code a deploy folder of its own, and a test keeps the PRODUCTION default under test

test_runbook_install_commands' installer step depended on the caller's graphics tool on PATH: a host card that cannot run the model server's image made the installer refuse, rightly; fixed: the step runs with the host's nvidia-smi off its PATH

the full set's console and poc stages allowed skips, so with no browser driver poc passed with all 7 tests skipped and console with 15; fixed: make test-console and make test-console-e2e run with TB_STRICT_SKIPS=1, as test-compose and test-walks, while the unit shards keep the browser tests' own skips

the compose test stack took TB_ENV and TB_DATA_CLASS from the caller's shell (every test-stack service has ${TB_ENV:-TEST}, and the full set passes its whole environment), so a shell exporting the host box's TB_ENV made the stack non-TEST and every unauthenticated test call a 401; fixed: COMPOSE_TEST and the failure drill set TB_ENV=TEST and TB_DATA_CLASS=D0
